notes:
Inbound: B2B SaaS (SaaS helpdesk + in-app assistant). Founder/CTO Priya Raman is technical. Small team (20 engineers).

Reason for outreach:
- Looking for hosted, self-serve inference (fast time-to-market).
- Primary requirement: streaming responses (token-by-token) for in-app chat UX. Live-typing feel is critical.
- Latency target: p95 <200ms on short-turn exchanges; baseline OK if cold-start higher but need steady-state <=200ms.
- Throughput modest: 30–100 concurrent active sessions during business hours; bursty after new release.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage runway conscious — wants predictable per-message economics and a simple estimator.

Technical preferences/asks from call:
- Prefer Redwood hosted API (no infra ops).
- Must support streaming websocket/HTTP chunking; SDK examples for TypeScript frontend + Node backend.
- Session context: need per-user KV of last ~2–4 messages persisted for 24 hours.
- Model prefs: open/smaller models acceptable if quality ok; want fallback routing to cheaper model when cost/latency tradeoffs arise.
- Telemetry: basic latency and cost per route; request-level traces helpful for debugging.

Security/compliance:
- Need SSO (SAML) for dashboard access.
- Audit logs desirable but not blocking. No strict data residency or SOC2 requirement yet (may change).

POC plan suggested by SE:
- 2-week integration spike using hosted streaming endpoint + small prompt set (3 intents).
- Success metrics: median latency <120ms, p95 <200ms, functional parity with their current mock responses, token cost <= $X per 1k tokens (TBD).
- Deliverables: sample TypeScript streaming SDK integration, perf report, cost estimate.

Quotes/notes from call:
- "We want the assistant to feel instant — users notice any lag." — Priya (CTO).
- "If you can show stable <200ms p95 on our sample workload we can move to a paid plan."

Commercials:
- Early ARR target: $5k–$20k/year (starter seat + usage). Likely start on pay-as-you-go and move to reserved once traction shows.

Next steps / immediate actions:
- Book 45min demo of streaming endpoints with engineering team (Marcus to coordinate).
- Share quickstart repo and cost estimator (done 2026-03-10).
- Customer to run integration spike and report back by 2026-03-24.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need concrete token cost examples for their conversation lengths (short prompts + ~150 tokens/response).
- Customer wants a live demo proving latency from East US to their users — may request test harness or synthetic traffic generator.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Good early-fit: technical buyers, self-serve mentality, low security overhead for now.
- Focus demo on streaming, p95 latency numbers, and cost calculator.
- Escalate if they ask for model quantization/packaged on-prem — likely later stage.
